claims.claim: The fixed affine-logit q12 softmax predicate, with d initial coordinates as parameter variables, has at most C(B+1)^d words on B predetermined queries. Initial probability need not be definable or have finite entropy.
An initial discrete branch of cardinality R_N plus arbitrary continuous initial coordinates has output entropy <=log R_N+log C+d log(B+1), for this fixed query class.

Using the paid BI/TR native bound, R_N<=12^N and fixed d cannot yield vanishing mean mismatch on N^2-transition actual late-iid HB bit records. The bounded-R_N subclass cannot match every fixed finite bit law either.

The same published theorem applies to fixed-degree classical polynomial/intensity thresholds of linear amplitudes or finite-mode waves with all phase coordinates retained, not to random Born outcomes or untyped nonlinear fields.
